releaseLabel: Build 017 — Unified Command Header, Workspace Controls & Department Intelligence

branding.primarySlogan: One World. One System. One Intelligent Network.

verification.header: unified Section 1 header with branding, profile, manager context, availability, local time, weather and intelligence shortcut
verification.globalClock: compact configurable locations saved in browser localStorage using IANA time zones
verification.departmentIntelligence: personal feed selection/add/remove/reorder with explicitly labeled sample items; live external news sources not connected
verification.footer: compact grouped company/support/privacy/legal/trust footer; policy pages are placeholders pending reviewed policy content
verification.workspacePersonalization: existing drag-and-drop modules retained; time-zone and department-feed preferences saved locally
verification.securityBoundary: front-end preview only; authentication, role enforcement, shared persistence and live data require backend/services

notes: Build 017 consolidates the requested visual and interaction changes. Personal preferences persist only in this browser preview. Department news is sample content, not live intelligence.
